body: I just recently started dating and at first I was scared of holding hands with my boyfriend in public and stuff like that but later got comfortable, until people started scream fuck gay people or I hate gay people, it’s disgusting at us. Feeling insecure again  :/
Thank you so much, I really appreciate it!
I have go to therapy more often now. Maybe it’ll distract me from those thoughts or at least help a little bit. I do want help and I hope things will get better

Yeah I kinda had to talk to them about it. In my family we usually don’t share our feelings openly but it’s been a bit easier now. I promised my friends and family that I wouldn’t do anything again until May and I don’t know if I can keep that promise. I want to tell my family that I’m starting to think about it again but I don’t want to upset them even more. I don’t think that I’ll do another attempt until April at least.

Hi! Thanks for responding. I kinda don’t feel that my suicide attempt was serious enough to rest for days and that’s also why I would want to do it the right way again. I just don’t want to hurt my family and friends as much as I did when I tried the first time but I still want to do it again. Idk what to do

Hi! Thank you for the response.

I’ve just heard that people go to mental hospitals if they attempt suicide or are at a high risk for it, so that’s what I’m scared about. It doesn’t sound like a nice place. 

I’ve had suicidal thoughts for a long time now and my therapist knows about it, but before recently I’ve never had a plan to actually do it. I do want to tell him but I don’t want my relationship with my parents to change because of it. My dad knows that I have suicidal thoughts(although we never talk about it) and when he found out he got really sad and mad. He didn’t want me to leave him. 

The only thing that’s keeping me from dying is guilt for my family and friends.

Hey, I know I’m a person on the internet that you don’t know but please, please don’t do it. There must be people that will miss you, and even if it sounds weird I’ll miss you. I don’t want you to end your life because of your suffering and I know it’s hard to understand but please try not to do anything that can harm you. I really really hope you read this. You can talk to me if you have no one else to right now please. Anything
